summary: Correct, minimal fix that extends call_command's kwargs-to-parse_args logic to include options belonging to a required mutually exclusive group, directly resolving the reported issue. Matches existing file conventions and introduces no regression.

issues.description: Relies on argparse private attributes (_mutually_exclusive_groups, _group_actions). This is consistent with the surrounding code which already uses parser._actions, so acceptable, but it is coupling to undocumented internals.
